title: Set the position and size of several layers at once
goal: Selecting four buttons and typing one width does nothing today: the position and size fields only ever show the layer you selected last. Make the fields work on the whole selection, so a row of controls can be made one width, or lined up on one X, in a single move.
notes: Follow-up from the-position-and-size-of-a-layer-can-be-typed-no (2026-09-03). The single-layer slice is GeometryInspector.swift + LayerGeometry/LayerGeometryEditing in PhotonzCore + EditorState.setLayerGeometry. Multi-selection lives in EditorState.multiSelectedLayerIDs; the batch shape to copy is the existing multi-select visibility/lock paths, which fold several updateLayer calls into one History.perform. Decide first what X means for a group (each layer to that X, or the group box moved there) - that is a UX decision card, not an engineering one.
acceptance: With two or more layers selected, the Position & Size section shows a number where they agree and a mixed marker where they do not
Typing a width sets every selected layer to that width in one undo step
Typing an X lines every selected layer up on that edge, and the section says which edge a number means
An arrow key steps every selected layer together

log.note: Pre-build review. The task notes asked whether X should mean 'every layer to that X' or 'move the group box there'. The acceptance list had already settled it ('Typing an X lines every selected layer up on that edge'), and it is also what every other design tool does, so no decision card: the group-box reading is what dragging already gives you. Cut from scope: a proportional lock and a rotation field, neither of which the task asks for. Shortest version that delivers the value is exactly the four acceptance items.

Built. PhotonzCore gained LayerGeometrySelection + LayerGeometryReading (agreed/mixed/empty), tested first: 15 tests in 'Typed geometry across a whole selection'. EditorState gained geometrySelection, setLayerGeometry(field:to:), stepLayerGeometry, all folded into one History.perform. GeometryInspector no longer takes a layer, it reads the selection; the panel shows the section on hasLayerSelection so it survives a multi-selection (selectedLayerID is nil then). A field acts only on the layers that accept it; the hover tip says 'Applies to 3 of the 4 selected layers.'

Verified on the probe with Scripts/playtest/multi-geometry-walk.json (Screen Recording granted, real captures). W=160 on three rectangles -> all 160, positions untouched; ONE undo restored 160/220/100; X=100 -> every left edge 100; up arrow on a Mixed Y -> 101/221/341, Shift up -> 111/231/351, spread kept; three rectangles plus an arrow, W=120 -> rectangles 120, arrow untouched. Scripts/test.sh green (1908 tests).

Position & Size now edits the whole selection: LayerGeometrySelection in PhotonzCore (15 tests), EditorState.setLayerGeometry(field:to:)/stepLayerGeometry folding every layer into one History.perform, GeometryInspector reading the selection and showing Mixed where layers differ. Verified on the probe with Scripts/playtest/multi-geometry-walk.json (real captures) and Scripts/test.sh green. Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-03-multi-geometry.json
